name: Wildlife
description:
Plants and animals people have photographed in Stratford and shared on iNaturalist. Set Confirmed to Yes to see only sightings other iNaturalist users have agreed on; the names of unconfirmed ones may be wrong. Only photos the photographer allows others to reuse are shown, and at-risk species, whose locations iNaturalist hides, are left out.

Click a dot to see the photo, who took it, and the sighting on iNaturalist. New sightings are added every day.
